testcase.name: Scenario: Minimize while a panel context menu is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:644:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Minimize while a panel context menu is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the display control is configured to toggle between the full ribbon and compact group buttons ✔ When the user right-clicks the Modify panel title ✔ Then the panel context menu opens ✔ When the user clicks the ribbon display control ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon shows compact group buttons ✔ And the part remains visible ✔ When the user clicks the ribbon display control again ✔ Then the full 3D Model ribbon returns ✔ And the context menu remains closed
